subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can listen to a description and find the right person.
I can play Guess who: Is it Sally? Yes, it is.
I can read and write about a family member.

tf.s: This is my sister, Ana. She's got black hair.
tf.why: Yes! Ana has got black hair.

tf.s: Is it Sally? Yes, it is.
tf.why: Well done! That is a short answer.

tf.s: We answer Is it Sally? with No, it isn't when it is not Sally.
tf.why: Yes! No, it isn't means it is not Sally.

tf.s: We say He's got for my aunt.

tf.s: She's got red hair and green eyes tells two things.
tf.why: Great! Hair and eyes are two features.

mcq.q: Read: This is my sister, Ana. Who is Ana?

mcq.why: Yes, it is answers a question.

mcq.q: Which word is a family word?
mcq.why: An aunt is in our family.

mcq.q: Your partner says: He's got black hair and big ears. Who is it?
o: A boy with black hair and big ears
A boy with fair hair and small ears
mcq.why: He is a boy with black hair and big ears.

mcq.q: Write about your brother. He has got brown hair.
mcq.why: For a brother: He's got brown hair.

mcq.q: You guess the person is Sally. What do you ask?
A girl has got red hair and green eyes. Which is NOT right?
o: She's got red hair and green eyes.
mcq.why: Her eyes are green, not blue.

mcq.q: Which is the best three-sentence description?
o: This is my mum. She's got black hair. She's got brown eyes.
This is my mum. He's got black hair. He's got brown eyes.
mcq.why: It says who she is and two features, with She's got.

mcq.q: Ana: black hair, blue eyes, small nose. Which picture is Ana?
o: Black hair, blue eyes, small nose
Red hair, blue eyes, small nose
Black hair, green eyes, big nose
Fair hair, brown eyes, small nose
mcq.why: Only this picture matches all three features.
